workflow.name: Fix an issue, approve, open a PR
workflow.description: Fix an issue, review it read-only, and let a person approve the review before post-processing commits, pushes and opens a pull request.

prompts.label: fix
prompts.text: Fix {{variables.issue_url}}. Add or update tests, run them, and describe the change.

prompts.label: review
prompts.text: Review the diff that fixes {{variables.issue_url}}: correctness, tests, risk. Say clearly whether it is ready to merge.

approval.prompt: Approve to commit, push and open the pull request for {{variables.issue_url}}. Reject to stop: nothing is committed.
